sources.supports: Three ceramides, hyaluronic acid, glycerin INCI, fragrance-free, dry skin, liberal application as needed. No ingredient percentages disclosed. Not a treatment for underlying skin conditions.
Apply after gently drying skin; persistent skin reactions warrant professional advice; use clean spoon for tubs; keep contaminated fabrics away from flames.
